Subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft & post-call next steps / Nova Health

Hi Emily / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached per our discussion. I captured the milestones we agreed on, proposed owners, and the initial target close date of 2025-10-15.

Highlights (from today's discovery):
- Priority: proof of concept (POC) for Redwood inference runtime with Nova's de-identified clinical notes workload.
- Key success criteria: avg token latency <= 250ms p95, and per-token cost below $0.0008 for steady-state.
- Dependencies: internal security questionnaire completion (SOC2 evidence), procurement/contract sign-off, and test data access for POC.

Attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_NovaHealth_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_draft_NovaHealth.pdf (initial SOW).

Ask: Please review the MAP and confirm owners/target dates or flag any changes. If the 2025-10-15 close looks aggressive, tell us and we'll reforecast.

Next steps I propose:
1) Your security/compliance team to provide SOC2 evidence / ATO checklist by 9/22.
2) Redwood to schedule a 1-week POC kickoff window (tentative 9/29).
3) Procurement to start contract review the week of 10/6.

Link to live MAP & deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/NW-3245

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,

Marissa —

Thanks for the write-up and the MAP. This is helpful. Quick update from our side: leadership reprioritized our Q4 initiatives this morning. The POC is still a go, but we need to push the procurement/contract timeline out. Tentatively we'd be looking at a close end of November rather than mid-October.

Separately, security wants to move the compliance evidence milestone earlier in the plan (they need time to review before the POC kickoff). Procurement won't be ready to start review until ~10/20 because of a separate RFP.

Can you update the MAP with a re-forecast close date (target 2025-11-30) and shift milestones so security review is completed before the POC kickoff? Happy to sync — can we do a 30-min call next Tue (9/16) to align owners and dates?

- Re-forecast target close date: 2025-11-30 (from 2025-10-15).
- Security/compliance milestone moved earlier: Security evidence due 2025-09-26 (owner: Nova Security) so review completes before POC kickoff.
- POC kickoff tentatively scheduled for 2025-10-20 (moved later to allow security review).
- Procurement / contract review moved to start 2025-10-20, with target sign on by 2025-11-30.
- Added explicit dependency: Redwood requires anonymized sample data and access window for POC by 2025-09-22 (owner: Nova Data Ops).

I've also added a row for acceptance criteria and a risk column. Rishi — can you review the updated milestone durations and confirm we can support a 10/20 POC start from capacity and pricing perspective?
